title: HSK2 Gate 22 · Republic of China
explanationEn: Gate 22: Republic of China. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第22关：民国。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝。可是那时候的日子很不好过，国家里面有问题，外面也有问题。很多人想：中国要不一样。有一个人叫孙中山，他年轻的时候学过医，会给人看病。
passageEn: A little over a hundred years ago, China still had an emperor. But life in those days was very hard, with trouble inside the country and outside it. Many thought: China must be different. There was a man called Sun Yat-sen, who had studied medicine when young and could treat the sick.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: A little over a hundred years ago, China still had an emperor.
comprehension.answer: 一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Many thought: China must be different.
comprehension.answer: 很多人想：中国要不一样。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 多 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“多”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 多 (duō) means "more than" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “多”（duō）的意思是“more than”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 年 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“年”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 年 (nián) means "years" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “年”（nián）的意思是“years”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝。

options.text: A little over a hundred years ago, China still had an emperor.
Long, long ago, it rained in China for many days, and a great flood came.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.

check.explanationEn: "一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝。" means "A little over a hundred years ago, China still had an emperor.".
check.explanation: “一百多年以前，中国还有皇帝。”的意思是“A little over a hundred years ago, China still had an emperor.”。
